name: The Pizzaria: Creeping Anemoia
desc:
[BEST EXPERIENCED ON PC WITH HEADPHONES AND HIGH GRAPHICS SETTINGS!]

This is a recreation of TigerCaptain's FNAF 1 Roblox game, titled The Pizzeria. Credit goes to TigerCaptain for the animatronic models shown ingame.

Return to or experience a new remix of The Pizzeria by TigerCaptain! Deal with new mechanics, new visuals, and an overall attempt to make the game more "modern" and scarier!

Though this is still just essentially yet Another FNAF 1 remake so don't expect anything too grand.
